'''Mantorr''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] species native to the shadow world of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. The species stood on two legs and had single sharp claws as front limbs. They had spikes along their back and a large horn atop their noses. Mantorrs spotted different colors and varied in size, from the small '''mantorin''' to individuals large enough to ride as mounts. [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] killed several mantorrs during the events of the [[Crisis on Umbara]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mantorrs were added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with patch 5.4 that introduced Umbara to the game. Besides appearing as enemies during the "Crisis on Umbara" flashpoint, Mantorr pet and mount were also made available from a Cartel Market pack.
